in_hebrew.name: Helbonna

in_latin.name: Helbonna
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Light, shining one
in_latin.long_meaning: Helbonna est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name Helios, meaning 'sun'. In Christianity, symbolizes the light of God and the hope of salvation.
